issues.t: sns: 4 net-new causes — identity-policy explicit Deny is ignored on GetSMSSandboxAccountStatus, a removed TopicInlinePolicy keeps authorizing Publish, a numeric MessageStructure=json branch is not delivered, and no FAILU
sns: delivery-status log records omit delivery.statusCode/providerResponse, and a feedback role with no logs permissions still writes a record (2 root causes)
sns: the lambda-protocol notification record omits SignatureVersion, Signature and SigningCertUrl, so a function cannot verify the notification it was invoked with
sns: 10 net-new wire divergences — ARN reference mistakes answer the wrong status, code and message, and four reads/writes report the wrong state
sns: delivery-status logging is entirely inert — no SUCCESS/FAILURE record and no sns/<region>/<account>/<topic> log group is ever written for any protocol

sns: removing an AWS::SNS::TopicInlinePolicy by stack update never restores the topic's default access policy, and the role it granted keeps publishing — the check cannot reach a verdict inside the 60 s cap

sns: 2 net-new root causes — Publish ignores the topic CMK's live state (PendingDeletion/Disabled), and an https subscription is never POSTed to so its DeliveryPolicy retry budget and dead-letter are inert
sns: 5 wire divergences — the opt-out check and the sandbox registration answer the wrong status, and three subscription responses carry the wrong text
sns: Unsubscribe's effect on SQS delivery is still unobservable — the pre-Unsubscribe baseline publish is not delivered and the check hangs to the 60 s cap (1 cause)
sns: filter-policy string operators do not decide delivery, and Unsubscribe's effect on delivery is unobservable — both checks hang without a verdict (2 causes)
